ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity light-grey/white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous zones occupying the central 70% of both lobes; low-intensity (black) pixels form a dense basal band at the peduncle junction and extend in a thinning gradient toward the distal tips along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 70-80 degree aperture; deep penetration relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; high-frequency variations with multiple peaks and valleys visible, particularly pronounced in the sections adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-relief, high-contrast white/grey pixel blobs situated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast dark linear marks; prominent vertical streak on the inner left lobe and multiple parallel diagonal streaks (rake marks) distributed across the central and outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of parallel linear tooth rake marks across both ventral surfaces and significant barnacle colonization on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.
